services.name: Canadian passport — regular service
services.sourceLabel: Government of Canada — Passport service standards

variants.label: In person — passport office / 10-day Service Canada location
variants.nextAction: If the published service standard has passed, check your application status using the official Passport Program service. A small number of files can take longer, especially if corrections, new photos, verifications or additional information are needed.
variants.refundNote: You may be eligible for an automatic fee refund under the Service Fees Act if the applicable remission rules are met.

variants.label: Regular Service Canada location, outreach site, mail or online
variants.nextAction: If the published service standard has passed, check your application status using the official Passport Program service. Mailing time is not included in the service standard.
variants.refundNote: You may be eligible for an automatic fee refund under the Service Fees Act if the applicable remission rules are met.

services.name: Canadian passport — urgent or express pickup
services.sourceLabel: Government of Canada — Passport service standards

variants.label: Urgent pickup
variants.standardText: By end of next business day
variants.nextAction: Use the pickup date provided by the passport officer as your primary date. If it has passed, contact the Passport Program or the office handling the application.

variants.label: Express pickup
variants.nextAction: This calculator uses the outer end of the published 2-to-9-business-day range. Use the pickup date provided by the passport officer if you were given one.

services.name: Complaint to a federally regulated bank
services.sourceLabel: Financial Consumer Agency of Canada — Bank complaint rights
sourceChecks: Ombudsman for Banking Services and Investments

variants.label: I made a complaint to my bank
variants.nextAction: A federally regulated bank must provide a detailed written response within 56 calendar days from when you first made the complaint. You may contact OBSI on the earlier of: more than 56 calendar days since you filed, or when the bank has provided its detailed written response and closed the file.

services.name: Federal access to information / personal information request
services.sourceLabel: Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat — How ATIP requests work

variants.label: Access to Information Act request
variants.nextAction: Federal institutions generally have 30 calendar days to respond. The deadline is counted from the day after receipt of a complete request; if it lands on a weekend or holiday, it moves to the next working day. A permitted extension can apply, and you should be notified within the first 30 days.

variants.label: Privacy Act personal information request
variants.nextAction: Federal institutions generally have 30 calendar days to respond. The deadline is counted from the day after receipt of a complete request; if it lands on a weekend or holiday, it moves to the next working day. Privacy Act requests may be extended in specified circumstances, so check any extension notice before treating the request as overdue.

variants.label: Digital — on-time, standard individual return
variants.nextAction: CRA's 2026–27 service standard is to issue a notice of assessment within two weeks for qualifying on-time digital T1 returns. The standard excludes several situations, including deceased, bankruptcy, international/non-resident, emigrant, multi-year and information-required files.

variants.label: Paper — on-time, standard individual return
variants.nextAction: CRA's 2026–27 service standard is to issue a notice of assessment within 12 weeks for qualifying on-time paper T1 returns. Some return types and files needing more information are excluded from this standard.

variants.label: Digital routine adjustment
variants.nextAction: CRA's 2026–27 service standard for a routine digital T1 adjustment is two weeks. Complex requests or files requiring additional review can take longer.

variants.label: Paper or telephone routine adjustment
variants.nextAction: CRA's 2026–27 service standard for a routine paper or telephone T1 adjustment is eight weeks. CRA's live processing time can be longer than the published service standard, so use the official source for the latest operational estimate.

variants.label: Online incorporation
variants.nextAction: Corporations Canada's current service commitment for online incorporation is one business day. Check the filing status or contact Corporations Canada if the published commitment has passed.

variants.label: Email or mail incorporation
variants.nextAction: Corporations Canada's current service commitment for incorporation submitted by email or mail is 10 business days.
